newsitem.title: USA: Anvil Holdings issues $30 mln exch preferred stk.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Holdings issues $30 mln exch preferred stk.

text.p: The following issue of exchangeable preferred stock from Anvil Holdings Inc was priced in the private placement market on Tuesday, according to manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
Anvil competes in the imprinted activewear segment of the casual apparel market.
